event_var.var_meaning: indicator of disease recurrence/progression (1 = recurrence/progression occurred; 0 = no recurrence/progression)

notes: Time and event fields are present in the GEO sample metadata in the 'Sample_characteristics_ch1' entry as part of a composite 'survival: ...' string (e.g. GSM4063814: 'survival: recurrence:1, progression-free-survival_days:144, live, overall-survival_days:234').
The paper defines PFS as 'length of time from the start of the anti-PD-1 antibody until progression' — the 'recurrence' field in the metadata appears to encode the progression event used for PFS.
Unit 'days' is inferred from the variable name suffix '_days' in the sample metadata.
Values for 'recurrence' observed across samples are '1' and '0' (recorded as shown in metadata).
Series metadata notes that 'sample "characteristics: survival" information has been updated on April 16, 2020.'

event_var.var_meaning: overall survival status (live = alive at last follow-up [censored]; dead = death event)

notes: Overall survival time and vital-status tokens appear in the GEO sample metadata within the same composite 'survival: ...' Sample_characteristics_ch1 entry (e.g. '..., live, overall-survival_days:234').
The paper defines OS as 'length of time from the date of diagnosis until death' — 'overall-survival_days' corresponds to this time and the unlabelled 'live'/'dead' tokens indicate censoring/event.
No separate explicit field name for vital status is provided beyond the 'survival' composite label in the metadata; thus 'survival' is used here as the event-field name exactly as it appears.
Unit 'days' is inferred from the variable name suffix '_days'; the paper reports medians in months but the sample metadata times are in days.
